categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Keyuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of chemical active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and pharmaceutical formulations. Its product portfolio covers key therapeutic areas including diabetes, anesthesia, cardiovascular, and psychiatric drugs. The company also operates a business segment producing chemical intermediates mainly for cosmetic applications. Additionally, it has a subsidiary focused on pharmaceutical formulations, supporting an integrated API and formulation business model.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis technologies and mature production processes for its core products such as Gliclazide, Metformin Hydrochloride, Ropivacaine Hydrochloride, and Isosorbide Mononitrate. It adheres to national GMP standards and has obtained multiple international certifications including EDQM, FDA, PMDA, and KFDA. The firm emphasizes continuous R&D investment, process optimization, and intelligent manufacturing, including automation upgrades and green production technologies aligned with industry environmental policies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large pharmaceutical companies and formulation manufacturers in China and internationally, particularly in Europe, South Africa, and the Middle East. The company serves downstream pharmaceutical formulation enterprises, distributors, and trade agents. Its products are included in national medical insurance and essential drug catalogs, supporting broad market access. The company also supplies intermediates to international cosmetic manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in East China, North China, Central China, Southwest China, and other domestic regions. It also exports products to overseas markets including Europe, South Africa, and the Middle East. The company maintains domestic production facilities in Shandong Province and has a growing international customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Keyuan Pharmaceutical operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the production of chemical APIs and intermediates. It also extends downstream into pharmaceutical formulations through its subsidiary, enabling an integrated supply chain from raw material synthesis to finished drug products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a technology-leading Chinese digital intelligent pharmaceutical innovation brand. It prioritizes R&D in chronic disease areas such as diabetes, anesthesia, cardiovascular, and psychiatric disorders, while expanding into digestive, hemostatic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory fields. Key R&D initiatives include new product development, process improvements, and intelligent manufacturing projects. The company invests in building a research institute, enhancing technical collaboration, and attracting specialized talent to strengthen innovation capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical APIs, pharmaceutical formulations, and chemical intermediates. The company employs a mix of direct sales, distributor sales, and trade agent sales domestically and internationally. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. The sales model includes direct sales to large pharmaceutical manufacturers and trade-based sales to cover smaller or distant customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the niche markets of its core APIs such as Gliclazide and Metformin Hydrochloride, supported by scale advantages and international certifications. It competes with other domestic and international API manufacturers and pharmaceutical formulation companies. Its integration of API and formulation production, along with strong R&D and quality control, differentiates it within the competitive pharmaceutical manufacturing industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 463.7 million, a 3.6% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 60.4 million, a 21.5% decrease year-over-year. Total assets reached RMB 1.55 billion, growing 5.6% year-over-year. The company has shown steady revenue growth but faces profit margin pressures due to pricing and cost factors. R&D investment accounted for over 8% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, certified pharmaceutical APIs and formulations with advanced technology and stable production processes. Its products have passed multiple stringent international regulatory certifications, ensuring global competitiveness. The integrated API and formulation business model enhances supply chain control and product value. The company’s focus on intelligent manufacturing, green production, and continuous R&D investment supports product differentiation and sustainable growth.
